Operate only on a new explicitly scoped branch within `YunRah2103/yunus-video-lab`. Existing approved GT3 RS meshes, wheels, engine, materials, livery and track assets must not be replaced without explicit permission. Use `production/advanced/` for original Blender export, pivot contracts, AO/normal bakes and clearance tests; `production/studio/studio.py inspect` for hierarchy and material inventory; and opt-in `production/tools/optimize_model.py` with GLB parent/pivot integrity checks. Provide SHA256, units, independent stills and true rotating turntable renders. No speculative accuracy certification.
